# Truth Weaver Counsel
> Truth Weaver Counsel is a Juss & Co. legal-information and notice-research tool. Public source records and guides are research aids, not legal advice, confirmed legal outcomes, or guarantees of legal coverage.

Canonical public website: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/
Parent organization: https://www.jussco.company/

## Public information
- Home and overview: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/
- Notice analyzer: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/notice-analyzer
- How source verification works: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/connectors
- Registered sources and their coverage limits: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/sources
- Legal library: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/legal-library
- Storefront and published availability: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/shop

## Verification boundaries
Only an official authority checked for the relevant jurisdiction, document, publication date and currentness can support verified-law claims. A registered source, draft offer, claim review, search index signal or model summary does not by itself prove legal truth or that a paid product is ready for sale.

## Private / excluded areas
Do not index, summarize, or request access to /merchant, /dashboard, /account, /issues, /fulfillment, or internal API endpoints. There are no public owner dashboards or public claim-evidence submissions.

Public sitemap: https://truthweaver.jussco.company/sitemap.xml
